findings.evidence: Integer.lean:144-145 and 152-153 are the same rewrite chain modulo `JO_def`/`OSet` vs `JX_def`/`XSet`. `Count.lean:152` already establishes `two_mul_J_singleton_left` as the file-set's idiom for stating that a doubled `J`-pairing is a natural number, so the missing lemma is out of step with the surrounding API. `grep -rn "two_mul" TauCeti/KnotTheory/Grid` shows no `JCenter`/`JCount` doubling lemma exists.
findings.fix: Add `GridPoint.two_mul_JCenter (s t) : 2 * JCenter s t = ((JNumCenter s t : ℕ) : ℚ)` (or the general `JCount`/`JNumCount` version in `JFunction/Basic.lean`) next to the existing `two_mul_J_singleton_left`, and reduce both proofs to `rw [maslovO_def, maslovOℤ, GridState.J_def, GridPoint.J_self, JO_def, OSet, ← GridPoint.two_mul_JCenter, ...]`.
findings.issue: `maslovO_eq_intCast` (l.143-147) and `maslovX_eq_intCast` (l.151-155) each inline the same reusable fact — `2 * GridPoint.JCenter s t = (GridPoint.JNumCenter s t : ℚ)` — as a nine-step `rw` chain ending in `push_cast; ring`. That fact is exactly what the module docstring names at l.24 ("2 · J_O(x) = JNumCenter(x, O) is an integer"), and it is what the deleted `GridPoint.JDiff_self_eq_intCast` used to supply as a named lemma; the PR removed it without a replacement, so the reason both proofs work is hidden inside them.

findings.evidence: Center.lean:199-203; `ICenter` is defined at Center.lean:81-82 as `Icount (· ≤ ·) s t` and `I` at Basic.lean:216-217 as `Icount IsSouthWest s t`, so the `rfl` is pure delta across two wrappers.
findings.fix: Replace the proof with `by simp only [JNumCenter, JNumCount, ICenter, I]`, or keep the `rw` and finish with `rw [← ICenter, ← I]`, so the unfoldings the proof depends on are explicit.
findings.issue: `JNumCenter_def` is `rw [JNumCenter, JNumCount_def]` followed by a bare `rfl`. After the rewrite the goal is `Icount (· ≤ ·) s t + Icount IsSouthWest t s = ICenter s t + I t s`, and the `rfl` closes it only by delta-unfolding `ICenter` and `I`. Nothing in the script or the docstring says which definitions are being unfolded, and it is the one place in the file where the wrapper equations are discharged by definitional equality instead of by name — `JCenter_def` two definitions below (l.264) names all three.

findings.evidence: Unknot.lean:206 declares `(a : Fin (n + 2))`; Unknot.lean:213 is `ext ⟨a, b⟩`; Unknot.lean:217 is `exact ⟨a, ha, rfl, rfl⟩`. Before the PR the lemma had no such parameter (diff: `p.1 ≠ Fin.last (n + 1) ∧ p.2 = f p.1`), so no collision existed.
findings.fix: Rename the destructured binders: `ext ⟨c, d⟩`, and adjust the two `exact`s accordingly.
findings.issue: `card_filter_graph` now takes the excluded column as a parameter `(a : Fin (n + 2))`, but the proof opens with `ext ⟨a, b⟩` (l.213), shadowing it. The subsequent `rintro ⟨ha, rfl⟩; exact ⟨a, ha, rfl, rfl⟩` reads as if `a` were the excluded column when it is in fact the pair's first component; the outer `a` survives only as an inaccessible `a✝`. The shadowing was introduced by this PR's generalization from the hard-coded `Fin.last (n + 1)`.

findings.fix: Drop the `by exact`: `theorem JNum_empty_left (s) : JNum ∅ s = 0 := JNumCount_empty_left _ _ s`, and likewise for the other seven.
findings.issue: Eight of the new re-export lemmas wrap a bare term proof in `by exact`, inconsistently with their immediate neighbours (`JNum_union_left` at l.440-442 is plain term mode against the same `JNumCount_*` family), which obscures that they are pure re-exports.

summary: The relation-parametric refactor is cleanly delegated and free of `show`/`change`, but the integrality argument that the deleted `JDiff_self_eq_intCast` used to carry is now inlined and duplicated in the two `maslov*_eq_intCast` proofs, and `JNumCenter_def` discharges its wrapper equations by an unexplained `rfl`.
